reader: Claude, second (careful) pass. Not blind: had seen the checker's 0 clashes and my first pass.
method: Every rule assigned to exactly one topic per folder. Every pair inside a topic checked; listed cross-topic pairs checked where topics touch. Each topic records the pairs looked at and why they are not clashes.

summary: 8 unsure pairs, 0 sure. 4 are new since the first pass (R229/R245, R229/R250, R142/R143, R4/R103). 7 of the 8 are tool choice or a 'permit' rule that acts as an exception to another rule; only R32/R47 is about git operations, and R48 resolves it. Our git model cannot express tool choice, so the checker cannot find those 7 by design.
labels: clash = no way to follow both; no clash = compatible or an exception is stated; ask the user = the rules are unclear about whether one is an exception to the other, so the agent should ask its user
